title: A venue reads its own allergen labelling as one printable matrix, unlabelled dishes included

steps.name: open the allergen matrix as an anonymous visitor
the Menu group offers the matrix
the matrix renders, and names the venue as the author of the data
steps.detail: Allergenopplysningene i dette dokumentet er registrert av Fixture Kafé AS. Vi gjengir dem uendret og har ikke undersøkt hva rettene inneholder.

steps.name: the columns are the venue's own allergen codes
a labelled dish carries the allergens the venue registered
steps.detail: Croissant: gluten, melk, egg marked; notter, selleri blank

steps.name: an unlabelled dish says so, instead of rendering five empty cells
steps.detail: IKKE MERKET — stedet har ikke registrert allergener for denne retten. Det betyr ikke at den er fri for allergener. Spør personalet.

steps.name: the sheet leads with how many dishes are unlabelled
steps.detail: 2 av 6 retter er ikke merket. Dette er derfor ikke en fullstendig allergenoversikt over menyen. | 6 retter · 4 merket · 2 ikke merket

steps.name: a blank cell is explained on the sheet itself
steps.detail: Slik leses tabellen: en prikk betyr at stedet har registrert allergenet på retten. Et tomt felt betyr at det ikke er registrert — det er ingen erklæring om at retten er fri for allergenet. Spør alltid personalet ved allergi.

steps.name: a dish that is off the menu is marked, not dropped
steps.detail: Sesongsalat is on the sheet, marked hidden

steps.name: in print media the admin chrome comes off and the document stays
steps.detail: controls, page header and nudges hidden; the sheet remains; left gutter 0px

steps.name: the honest sentences survive the printer
steps.detail: author line, unlabelled alarm, reading rule, the unlabelled statement and the legend all on the paper

steps.name: render it to A4 and keep the PDF as the paper evidence
a venue with no allergen list prints an alarm, not an empty matrix
steps.detail: Stedet har ikke satt opp noen allergenliste, så ingen rett kan være merket. Ingenting nedenfor sier at en rett er fri for noe.

steps.name: and the page tells the manager what to do about it
steps.detail: Stedet har ingen allergenliste ennå. Uten den kan ingen rett merkes.
